faq.notFoundDesc: Try different keywords or choose another category

1.question: Are divination results accurate?
1.answer: Results are analyzed based on your inputs and chosen method. Please combine them with rational thinking as one reference for life guidance.

2.question: How to choose the right method?
2.answer:
Different methods suit different questions:
• BaZi: deep life pattern analysis
• Tarot: emotions and relationships
• Guanyin sticks: seeking guidance
• Astrology: traits and fortune
Choose according to your needs.

3.question: Is my personal information protected?
3.answer:
We value privacy:
• Encrypted storage
• No third-party sharing
• You can modify/delete data
• Records are visible only to you

4.question: How long does a reading take?
4.answer:
Durations vary:
• Quick tests: 1–2 min
• Tarot: 3–5 min
• BaZi: 5–10 min
• Ziwei: 8–15 min
Depends on complexity and network.

5.question: Can I repeat the same question?
5.answer: Avoid repeating in a short time. If circumstances change or enough time has passed (suggest ≥1 month), you can ask again.

6.question: How to improve accuracy?
6.answer:
To improve results:
• Complete your profile
• Ask a specific question
• Be sincere
• Choose good timing
• Describe details

7.question: Can results change destiny?
7.answer:
Divination analyzes current trends, not fixed fate. Understanding directions helps you:
• Make informed choices
• Prepare for challenges
• Seize opportunities
• Adjust mindset and actions
Change comes from your actions.

8.question: What are check-in and wish wall for?
8.answer:
Check-in:
• Daily points
• Streak bonuses
• Unlock features with points
Wish wall:
• Record wishes
• Share positivity
• Review progress regularly
